about: One question per run, each about one line of a router file (the needle file), taken from whole-repo-qa/questions.json with the path made explicit (two repos are in the prompt). Right = every regex in `answer` matches the ANSWER text, case-insensitive.

questions.q: What is the name of the diagnostics_channel TracingChannel that router/lib/layer.js creates for request tracing?
In router/lib/route.js, when a route has no HEAD handler, which method name is a HEAD request treated as?
Which exact version of mocha does router/package.json list in devDependencies?
